summary: Iteration 57 - All features tested and working. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All new UI components verified including PersonalReportsPage, PayPalWalletPage, UpgradePromoBanner, EasterEggRewardHistory, Quick Links, Maestro Bistro food images, and Legal documents.
critical_code_review_comments: PersonalReportsPage.js - Well-implemented CRUD UI with image upload, location detection, category assignment. All form fields have proper data-testid attributes.
PayPalWalletPage.js - Complete wallet dashboard showing pending balance, total earned, payout history. Admin section shows all wallets with process payouts functionality.
UpgradePromoBanner.js - Admin-configurable promotional message about pay-as-you-go model with API cost breakdown (Google Maps, AI Search, SerpAPI, Email Services).
FloatingEasterEggs.js - EasterEggRewardHistory component added with filter tabs (All, Protocol Ideas, Jokes, Pricing Tips, Motivation, Fun Facts, Secrets) and social sharing features.
BookPromoBanner.js - Real Maestro Bistro food photography images added (Beef Rouladen, Vegetable Rouladen, Fish Chowder) with proper alt tags.
SettingsPage.js - Quick Links section added with buttons to Personal Reports, Wallet, Subscribe pages. All buttons have proper data-testid attributes.
